rows.en: Hahaha...! You're already finished. You'll never stand against me again!!
Like I could stay asleep... at a time like this...!!
You took that attack head-on! How are you still standing!?
Hahahaha!! But you're wounded, after all. You won't last long!!
Raaaaaaaagh!! What are you waiting for!? Now!!
Hey, we're out of time! Let's smash that device!
Ankh and the others destroyed the device attached to the Gaia Gate.
Most of the memories have already been installed...
What!? Installed? What's that supposed to mean!?
This Veda you speak of... where is it!?
It isn't in this Cube... It's already too late...
Even if the "Gaia Impact" ends in failure, our next plan will far surpass it...
But either way, you lot are fated to be wiped out by the Dinosaur Greeed...
There's nothing you can do now...
I have no regrets in my life!!
So Veda is in another Cube...?

notes.note: No speaker; script plays the Jet Memory SE here, so this is Accel's Engine Blade / Memory voice call. Caps in double quotes per glossary style.
Terror Dopant hit by Accel's surprise Jet shot; 'kisama' cut off, rendered 'You...!!'.
Accel, who had been knocked out earlier, getting back up. Subject 'I' implied by 'Like I could'.

#0.33-47, #0.56-70, #0.76-90 and #0.101-112 (continuing to #0.114 in story_108) are leader-variant blocks. Order from 0587.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain: W (Shotaro), Rider 1, OOO, Momotaros, Zero, Mebius, Nu, Zeta, Black RX, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam. Wording fits this order (polite -san rows at slots 3/6, 'omee' at slot 4, 00/Wing Zero lines at 13/14).
OOO's '-san' on Accel dropped per honorifics rule; same for #0.38 (Mebius). Identical English to the plain rows.
Momotaros: 'omee!!' (rough 'you!!') as surprised admiration; rendered 'Why, you!!'.
Terror Dopant asks how Accel survived/keeps going after the attack; 'still standing' makes the implied question explicit.
Accel's catchphrase (ore ni shitsumon wo suru na) per glossary 'Don't ask me.', stretched to match the long cry.
Accel holding the Terror Dopant and yelling at the party to strike; 'nani shiteru' rendered idiomatically as 'What are you waiting for!?'.
Slot 4 = Momotaros (yossha); 'Hell yeah!!' for his rough voice.
Slot 13 = 00 (Setsuna): 'yatta no ka' as an uncertain 'Did we do it...?'. #0.69 = Wing Zero (Heero) 'Mission complete'.
Ankh to the party; 'we' restored for the shared action.
Narration: 'Ankh-tachi' rendered 'Ankh and the others'.
Context from later rows in this table (#0.183-184, played between #0.75 and #0.76): Terror Dopant turned memories into data and installed them into Veda. 'Memories' kept vague as in the source.

Veda (00's quantum computer) not in glossary; established English name used, matching existing 'Veda!?' / 'Veda Cube' rows. Slot 1 (W) has the curter 'doko ni aru' form, so 'Where's Veda!?'; slot 2 (Rider 1) formal; slot 5 (Zero) 'tte no wa' casual. #0.90 is not referenced by the +75+13 call but follows the same pattern, so treated as slot 15.
'Gaia Impact' in quotes as in the source (Regis's plan).
Ikadevil; 'kisamara' rendered 'you lot'.
Terror Dopant's (Ryubee Sonozaki) dying line before the three villains self-destruct (explosion SE follows).

#0.98-99 are one cry split over two speakers: Garagaranda 'Shocker Army...' + Ikadevil 'Banzaaai!!'. Glossary renders Shocker banzai as 'Long live Shocker!'; to keep the Japanese order across rows, cut as 'Shocker Army...' / 'Long may it liiiiiiive!!'.
Slot 4 = Momotaros ('tte no ka', rough). Block #0.101-114 has 14 rows; slot 15 (God Gundam) has no row in the table.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant order taken from the 0587.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain and confirmed by wording. #0.30 treated as a Memory voice ('JET'). #0.98-99 split 'Long live the Shocker Army' as 'Shocker Army...' / 'Long may it liiiiiiive!!'. #0.90 inferred as slot 15. Veda is not in the glossary (established 00 name used).
